introHtml: Custom PL wine carriers and totes combine the durability of polypropylene with the elegance needed for wine packaging. Whether you need a single-bottle bag for corporate gifts or a multi-bottle tote for client appreciation events, PL material offers a lightweight yet sturdy structure that resists moisture and wear. These carriers accept screen printing or debossing, making them ideal for showcasing your brand at trade shows or as high-end promotional giveaways.
